nodes.description: Final material attributes used by the GLSL preview and by the UE5 import.
Writes single-layer water volume properties: scattering, absorption, phase function and color behind the water surface.
Sets transmittance color and surface coverage for the Thin Translucent shading model.
Overrides the clear-coat normal separately from the base material normal.
A single floating-point constant.
A two-component constant vector.
A three-component constant vector / color.
A four-component constant vector / color.
A scalar material parameter. Emitted as a uniform and exported as a UE5 ScalarParameter.
A vector material parameter. Emitted as a uniform and exported as a UE5 VectorParameter.
Adds two values. Numeric types are promoted.
Subtracts B from A. Numeric types are promoted.
Multiplies two values. Numeric types are promoted.
Divides A by B. Numeric types are promoted.
Raises A to the power of B.
Component-wise minimum of A and B.
Component-wise maximum of A and B.
Component-wise floating-point remainder.
Absolute value of each component.
Smallest integer not less than the input.
Largest integer not greater than the input.
Fractional part of each component.
Rounds each component to the nearest integer.
Square root of each component.
Returns 1 - Input for every component.
Sine of each component.
Cosine of each component.
Tangent of each component.
Clamps each component to the 0..1 range.
A compact pass-through node for routing a connection.
A resizable comment box for organizing the graph.
Returns -1, 0 or 1 for each component.
Discards the fractional part of each component.
Base-2 logarithm of each component.
Inverse sine of each component.
Inverse cosine of each component.
Inverse tangent of each component.
Returns 1 when A is greater than B.
Returns 1 when A is greater than or equal to B.
Returns 1 when A is less than B.
Returns 1 when A is less than or equal to B.
Returns 1 when A equals B (within tolerance).
Returns 1 when A does not equal B.
Selects between the A > B, A == B and A < B values. Equivalent to MaterialExpressionIf.
Chooses A when Pick is greater than 0.5, otherwise B.
Selects True or False at compile time. Also exported as a static switch.
Rotates a position around an axis by Angle radians.
Appends the components of A and B into a larger vector.
Selects R/G/B/A channels from the input. The output type follows the number of enabled channels.
Splits a Vector2 into its scalar components.
Splits a Vector3 into its scalar components.
Splits a Vector4 into its scalar components.
Length (magnitude) of a scalar or vector.
Distance between two scalars or vectors.
Smooth Hermite interpolation between Min and Max.
Returns 0 when Value is below Edge, otherwise 1.
Returns Input * Scale + Bias.
Masks based on the distance from A to B inside Radius.
Deterministic value noise from a 3D position.
Linear interpolation between A and B by Alpha.
Clamps Value between Min and Max.
Dot product of two vectors. Returns a scalar.
Cross product of two three-component vectors.
Returns a unit-length vector. Useful for normals and directions.
Blends a color toward its luminance using Fraction.
View-angle fresnel term. This preview uses the geometric normal.
Mesh UV coordinates scaled by U/V tiling.
Scrolls UV coordinates over time. Time defaults to the material time.
Rotates UV coordinates around a center point over time.
Offsets UV coordinates using a height value. The preview uses a simple parallax approximation without view-dependent depth.
Global material time in seconds.
World-space position of the shaded pixel.
Interpolated world-space vertex normal.
Normalized world-space vector from the shaded pixel to the camera.
Distance from the preview camera to the shaded pixel.
Scene depth at the shaded pixel. The preview approximates it with camera distance.
World-space position of the preview camera.
World-space position of the preview object (origin).
World-space position of the owning actor (origin in the preview).
Direction toward the key studio light.
Camera vector reflected around the surface normal.
Normalized screen-space position (viewport UV).
Current preview viewport size in pixels.
Vertex color. The preview mesh has no vertex colors, so this is white.
Front/back facing sign. The preview is single-sided, so this is 1.
Shared texture sampler settings. Connect to a TextureSample Sampler input.
A texture asset reference. Connect it to a TextureSample's Texture input.
A named texture parameter that can be overridden per material instance.
Samples a texture. UVs default to the mesh UV0 channel.
Texture sample exposed as a named texture parameter.
Scene texture sampling node. Preview provides Color/Size/InvSize but uses a neutral placeholder color because scene capture is not linked in this version.
Calls a reusable blueprint function asset. Drag a function asset from the Content Browser or the Material Functions section into the graph.
Exposes a named typed input on a blueprint function.
Collects a named typed result from a blueprint function.
